m1_finding_text.claim: The PR removes `noncomputable` from `Finset.monoid` but leaves the same modifier on its sibling instances in the very same file: `Finset.commMonoid` (line 939), `Finset.divisionMonoid` (line 964) and `Finset.divisionCommMonoid` (line 1020), as well as on `Finset.coeMonoidHom` (line 770). I verified each one is no longer needed: replacing the modifier-carrying line by the same line without `noncomputable` makes the file compile with no errors (Lean reports `axiom ... not supported by code generator; consider marking definition as 'noncomputable'` for a genuinely noncomputable `def`, so a clean compile does prove the definition is computable). This is exactly the inconsistency the modification was meant to fix: on the `Set` side `Set.commMonoid`, `Set.divisionMonoid` and `Set.divisionCommMonoid` were all de-`noncomputable`d, while their `Finset` counterparts were not.
m1_finding_text.requested_change: Also drop `noncomputable` from `protected def commMonoid` (939), `protected def divisionMonoid` (964), `protected def divisionCommMonoid` (1020) and `def coeMonoidHom` (770), so that the modifier is applied uniformly to the family (or record in a comment why these specific ones must keep it).
